dataDisclosure: The add-on sends the text prompt or reference image you submit to the public Forge API on three.ws over HTTPS and downloads the finished .glb. It sends a random per-install client handle for rate limiting. It reads no files other than the reference image you choose, writes the downloaded model to the system temp directory and deletes it after import, and sends no telemetry. Every network path checks Blender's Allow Online Access preference and the --offline-mode flag first.
releaseNotes: 1.0.0: first public release. Generate a model from a text prompt or reference image with the free Forge pipeline on three.ws, test the connection against the live backend list, and import the result into the scene with Blender's own glTF importer.
tagline: Generate 3D models from text or images with Forge by three.ws
description: Generate a textured 3D model from a text prompt or a reference image with the free Forge pipeline on three.ws, straight into your Blender scene. The add-on adds a three.ws panel to the 3D Viewport sidebar with a prompt field, a quality tier and a Generate button, plus a Test connection button that lists the live Forge backends. The finished .glb is imported with Blender's own glTF importer, so there is no custom mesh parser. It respects the Allow Online Access preference and the offline-mode flag, uses only the Python standard library and installs on a read-only profile. Every call goes to the live public three.ws API.

submission.upload: extensions.blender.org/submit: upload the zip built with `blender --command extension build` from integrations/blender/three_ws. Steps and the post-publish checks are in integrations/blender/SUBMITTING.md.
submission.media: Icon 256x256 and a featured image 1920x1080 rendered at dist/engine-stores/blender/artwork, plus at least one screenshot of the sidebar panel with an imported model.
submission.note: The sidebar panel and the modal Generate operator need an interactive Blender window, so the owner checks them during the local smoke test in SUBMITTING.md.
